description: This file defines the interface for the libparodus library, including data structures, error codes, and function prototypes for initializing, sending, receiving, and shutting down the libparodus service, which provides connectivity to the parodus service.

methods.name: libparodus_init
methods.description: Initializes the libparodus interface with configuration parameters, creating an instance for subsequent API calls.

methods.name: libparodus_receive
methods.description: Receives the next message sent to the service, waiting up to a specified timeout.

methods.name: libparodus_close_receiver
methods.description: Sends a close message to the receiver to terminate message reception.

methods.name: libparodus_shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the libparodus interface and releases resources.

methods.name: libparodus_send
methods.description: Sends a WRP message to the parodus service.

methods.name: libparodus_strerror
methods.description: Returns a string describing a libparodus error code.
